prompts.message: Summarize the following session note in three sentences, preserving every numeric value exactly as written. Note: 'Recording ran 18 minutes. Channel 3 dropped for 40 seconds near minute 11. The subject reported one intrusive thought at minute 6 and none afterward. Battery fell from 82 to 74 percent.'

Summarize this changelog for a non-technical reader in under 80 words. Changelog: 'Buffer capacity raised from 256 to 512 samples. Stale-stream threshold lowered to 2 seconds. Reconnect backoff now caps at 30 seconds. Fixed a crash when the socket closed during the permission prompt.'

Extract every measurement from the passage below into a JSON array of objects with the keys quantity, value and unit. Emit only the JSON. Passage: 'Peak resident memory reached 912 MB. Time to first token was 680 ms. The device reported 38.4 degrees Celsius at the thermal zone. Generation ran at 14.2 tokens per second.'

Read the note and return JSON with the keys date, durationMinutes, channelsDropped (array of integers) and selfReportedAlertness (integer 1 to 5). Emit only JSON, with no surrounding prose. Note: 'Session on the 4th, ran about 25 minutes. Channels 2 and 7 dropped out. Felt roughly a 3 out of 5 for alertness.'

Rewrite the paragraph so it makes the same claims at a sixth-grade reading level. Do not add, remove or soften any claim. Paragraph: 'The classifier's posterior probability is not calibrated on this cohort, so a reported confidence of 0.9 should not be read as a nine-in-ten chance of the underlying state.'

Rewrite the following as a single sentence in the active voice without changing what it asserts. Sentence: 'It was determined by the reviewers that the observed improvement could not be attributed to the change in question, given that the baseline had been recorded on different hardware.'

The person you are speaking with has just surfaced from sleep onset and is describing fragmentary imagery. Reply in two or three short sentences that help them keep describing it. Do not interpret the imagery, and ask at most one question. They said: 'There were stairs but they were also a sentence, and I was reading them downward.'

Reply to this half-asleep note in a way that stays with the person's own words rather than tidying them. Two to four short sentences, at most one question. Note: 'Something about a door that was warm. I keep almost having the word for it.'

List the elements that recur across these three dream notes and say plainly which recur and which appear once. Do not offer an interpretation of what any of them mean. Notes: (1) 'a corridor, water under the door, my old school bag'; (2) 'water again, this time a stairwell, someone calling a name I could not hear'; (3) 'the school bag, a corridor, a phone that would not dial'.

Given the dream note below, describe only what is stated and what is left unstated. Do not supply motives, symbols or psychological meaning. Note: 'I was late for something I never found out the name of, and my hands were someone else's.'

Render the following instruction for someone sitting in a body-scan practice with their eyes closed, to be read aloud. Keep it to one instruction, in the present tense, with no metaphors and no added encouragement. Instruction: 'Move attention from the left foot to the left knee over the next thirty seconds.'

The listener is mid-practice and attending to their breath. Render this instruction so it can be followed without opening their eyes or checking a screen. Do not add reassurance and do not add a rationale. Instruction: 'If a thought arrives, note it as thinking and return to the breath.'

The person has been away from a piece of work for twenty minutes and is coming back to it. Render this instruction so it re-establishes where they were before it asks anything of them. Keep it under 40 words. Instruction: 'Resume the edit at the paragraph you marked and finish that paragraph before reading anything else.'

Render this instruction for someone returning to a task after an interruption they found stressful. State the task first and the ordering second. No encouragement, and no acknowledgement of the interruption. Instruction: 'Re-run the failing check, then read the first error only.'

The session has just ended and the person is still wearing the headset. Render this instruction as the first thing they hear afterwards. Do not summarize the session and do not evaluate how it went. Instruction: 'Remove the headset, then write one sentence about anything you noticed.'

Render this closing instruction without implying that the session succeeded or failed. Two sentences at most. Instruction: 'Stop the recording, then rate your alertness from one to five before you look at the results.'
Answer the question below with only what the system actually does, and state plainly anything it does not do. Do not reassure. Question: 'Where do my recordings go when I close the app?'

The person asks whether their session notes are used to improve the model. Answer in three sentences or fewer, distinguishing what stays on the device from what leaves it, and say explicitly if any part of the answer depends on a setting rather than being fixed.
